title: Rulebook
lede: Nine rules that survived thirty rounds and about two thousand prompts. Each rule is one sentence and three copyable prompts, cited by tag id into docs/prompts/exploration-log.txt. Proof images attach one keeper at a time, with the prompt captured at harvest.

rules.title: One ink, then restraint
rules.statement: Pick one ink and commit: Prussian blue cyanotype on cream, phosphor green on near-black, or black on foxed cream with a single small red mark. Never navy plus gold, never rainbow by default. Color is the minority lane, not the house style.

rules.title: Texture is the medium
rules.statement: Every image goes through a print or early-digital process: risograph misregistration, halftone rosette, Bayer dither, thermal-receipt grain, xerox degradation, CRT scanlines. Clean renders read as stock. When it looks too smooth, add one texture clause.

rules.title: Statuary in, living faces out
rules.statement: No photographic or living human faces. Classical marble statuary, busts, reliefs, and caryatids are approved as art objects: gods in the machine, glitched into dither. Machine habitat, not portraiture.

rules.title: Only the real lexicon
rules.statement: Text stays anchored to words Nous actually uses: NOUS RESEARCH and HERMES first, project names rarely. Latin letters only, no invented slogans, no Greek script. Match the word to the subject: a bazaar can say open source, a cathedral cannot.

rules.title: Neoclassical meets machine habitat
rules.statement: Subjects fuse the classical and the computational: colonnades dissolving into server racks, brutalist compute-cathedrals, cartouches, orreries, blueprint schematics. Scenes beat diagrams; keep labeled-diagram prompts under a third of any batch.

rules.title: The spectral break
rules.statement: The deliberate break from print texture is false-color sensor imagery: FLIR thermal, Aerochrome infrared, UV fluorescence, X-ray, night vision, schlieren, lidar. Wordmarks become HUD labels and scale bars. Moodboard grain reads as sensor noise here, so keep it on.

rules.title: Setup on Midjourney 8.2
rules.statement: Personalize on with Personalization profile #1 and the hermes moodboard both checked; confirm both tags on the job card. Draft mode on. Chaos and weird from the UI, never in the prompt. No --sref on the classical lane, and --sw is dead while any moodboard is attached: stack references to dilute instead.

rules.title: Discovered styles: technique transfers, atmosphere swallows
rules.statement: Roll --sref random to discover styles, then read the seed off the job card. Seeds that encode rendering technique (linework, palette, print process) transfer to any subject and keep the wordmark. Seeds that encode atmosphere erase subject and wordmark; use them only on the off-brief lane.

rules.title: The Nous Girl rides as an image prompt
rules.statement: On 8.2 her reference goes first in the prompt as a bare image URL with --iw 1.5. Identity holds, palette survives, the scene survives only if the subject is not itself a figure: pair her with architecture, instruments, and machines, never statuary. --oref and --cref are refused; --iw 3 collapses to monochrome portraits.

archive_note: Twenty-four frames from the May 2026 corpus that have an exact prompt on disk. They were made before this rulebook existed, with Midjourney v6-era flags, and no entry claims a rule. Each shows its verbatim prompt and the prompts-file line it came from. The other 173 files on the archive page have no recoverable prompt and get nothing invented.
